checks.text: The page heading reads "Warranty Tracker" and, with no records, the table area shows the text "No warranties yet".

In the "Add warranty" form, typing "Laptop" in the field labelled "Product name", "2024-01-15" in the field labelled "Purchase date", and "2027-01-15" in the field labelled "Warranty end", then clicking the button "Save warranty", adds a row to the table containing "Laptop", "2024-01-15", "2027-01-15" and the status badge "Active".
After adding a second warranty with Product name "Phone", Purchase date "2023-06-01", Warranty end "2024-06-01", the table shows two rows and the "Phone" row displays the status badge "Expired".
Clicking the column header "Product name" in the table sorts rows alphabetically by product name; with "Laptop" and "Phone" present, "Laptop" appears before "Phone".
Typing "lap" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row containing "Laptop"; the "Phone" row is hidden.

Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose content includes the header row "Product name,Purchase date,Warranty end,Status" and a data row containing "Laptop,2024-01-15,2027-01-15,Active".
Clicking the button "Delete Laptop" on the Laptop row removes that row from the table; the table then shows only the "Phone" row and the text "No warranties yet" is not displayed.

Clicking the tab labelled "Expiring soon" switches to a second view that lists only warranties whose end date is within 90 days of today; with "Laptop" ending 2027-01-15 and "Phone" ending 2024-06-01, the "Expiring soon" view shows the "Phone" row and does not show the "Laptop" row.

Reload keeps the warranty record: after adding "Laptop" with Purchase date "2024-01-15" and Warranty end "2027-01-15", reloading the page still shows a table row containing "Laptop", "2024-01-15" and "2027-01-15".
